Name: Customize Anywhere
Author: CherryChain
Description:
Lets you customize your character and access a wardrobe with all clothing from anywhere, or via in-game Clothing Catalogue and Customization Mirror items.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
You can buy the recipes for a Customization Mirror and Clothing Catalogue from Robin's shop for 50,000g each. They can be crafted with 10 wood + 2 refined quartz and 10 wood respectively. You can place them in the world, then interact with them to open the character customization screen and a clothing catalogue (which includes custom clothing added by other mods).

You can also use these key bindings to access the features:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]LeftShift + 1[/font]: open the character customization screen.
[*][font=Courier New]LeftShift + 2[/font]: open the dyes menu (if you saw the event that unlocks dyeing).
[*][font=Courier New]LeftShift + 3[/font]: open the tailoring menu (if you saw the event that unlocks tailoring).
[*][font=Courier New]LeftShift + 4[/font]: open the clothing catalogue.
[/list]
You can optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure...
[list]
[*]whether the above key binds are enabled;
[*]whether you can open the tailoring UI before you unlock tailoring in the base game;
[*]and the key binds.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does this add new character options or clothing?[/b][/size]
No, this just provides a convenient way to customize your character or clothing. There are many mods which add new clothing those, which should work fine alongside this mod.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep. Removing the mod won't undo the character customizations or clothing you chose.[/quote]
